title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 1: Phantom Blood
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In 1880s England, the poor and ambitious Dio Brando is adopted by the wealthy Joestar family and schemes to take the fortune from his adoptive brother, Jonathan. After poisoning his adoptive father, Dio uses an ancient stone mask to become a vampire, and Jonathan trains in Hamon, a sunlight-based breathing technique, to stop him and his zombie army.
life_message: It holds up courage, gentlemanly honor and the human ability to overcome hardship through one's own effort, passed on to the next generation.
